command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

tar -xf rad.tar

echo "== A: --min-reads 1 -- every planted cell must survive =="
alevin-fry generate-permit-list -d fw -i rad -o qdA --unfiltered-pl barcodes.txt --min-reads 1 > gpA.log 2>&1
alevin-fry collate -i qdA -r rad -t 2 > colA.log 2>&1
alevin-fry quant -i qdA -o resA -m t2g.tsv -r cr-like -t 2 > qA.log 2>&1

echo "== B: DEFAULT --min-reads -- demonstrates the silent low-count-cell drop =="
alevin-fry generate-permit-list -d fw -i rad -o qdB --unfiltered-pl barcodes.txt > gpB.log 2>&1
alevin-fry collate -i qdB -r rad -t 2 > colB.log 2>&1
alevin-fry quant -i qdB -o resB -m t2g.tsv -r cr-like -t 2 > qB.log 2>&1

# rebuild the (barcode, gene, count) triples from the MatrixMarket output
mk() { awk 'NR==FNR{r[FNR]=$1; next} FNR==1{next} FNR==2{next} FNR==3{next} {print r[$1]"\tg"$2"\t"$3}' \
        "$1/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt" "$1/alevin/quants_mat.mtx" | sort; }
mk resA > gotA.tsv; mk resB > gotB.tsv
echo "--- A (min-reads 1) ---"; cat gotA.tsv
echo "--- B (default) ---";     cat gotB.tsv

CELLS_A=$(wc -l < resA/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt | tr -d ' ')
CELLS_B=$(wc -l < resB/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt | tr -d ' ')
SUM_A=$(awk '{s+=$3} END{print s+0}' gotA.tsv)
READS=$(awk '/reads/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="mapped_planted") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)
EXACT_A=no; cmp -s truth.tsv gotA.tsv && EXACT_A=yes
DROPPED=$(comm -23 <(cut -f1 truth.tsv | sort -u) <(cut -f1 gotB.tsv | sort -u) | tr '\n' ' ')

# ---- unmapped reads: piscem's file, decoded here, then featureDump's CorrectedReads ----
# piscem 0.23.0 writes unmapped_bc_count.bin as a 3-byte header (version 1, 1 field, type 3 = u32)
# then (u32 barcode, u32 count) records, little-endian, barcode 2 bits/base, first base high.
UB=rad/unmapped_bc_count.bin
UHDR=$(od -An -v -tu1 -N3 "$UB" | tr -s ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')
od -An -v -tu4 -j3 "$UB" | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) f[++k]=$i}
  END{ if(k%2) {print "odd"; exit 1}
       for(i=1;i<=k;i+=2){ v=f[i]; s=""; for(p=15;p>=0;p--){ s=s substr("ACGT", int(v/2^(2*p))%4+1, 1) } c[s]+=f[i+1] }
       for(b in c) print b"\t"c[b] }' | sort > bin_unmapped.tsv
awk -F'\t' '$3>0{print $1"\t"$3}' truth_reads.tsv | sort > want_unmapped.tsv
BIN_OK=no; cmp -s want_unmapped.tsv bin_unmapped.tsv && BIN_OK=yes
# every featureDump row: MappedReads == planted mapped, CorrectedReads == planted mapped + unmapped,
# MappingRate == mapped / (mapped + unmapped). Written as "all equal" so a NaN cannot pass.
fdcheck() { awk -F'\t' 'NR==FNR{m[$1]=$2; u[$1]=$3; next} FNR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)c[$i]=i; next}
  { n++; r=m[$1]/(m[$1]+u[$1]); d=$c["MappingRate"]-r; if(d<0)d=-d
    if (($1 in m) && $c["MappedReads"]==m[$1] && $c["CorrectedReads"]==m[$1]+u[$1] && d<=1e-6) ok++
    printf "%s mapped %s corrected %s rate %s; ", $1, $c["MappedReads"], $c["CorrectedReads"], $c["MappingRate"] > "/dev/stderr" }
  END{ print ok+0, n+0 }' truth_reads.tsv "$1/featureDump.txt"; }
read -r FD_OK_A FD_N_A < <(fdcheck resA 2>fdA.txt)
read -r FD_OK_B FD_N_B < <(fdcheck resB 2>fdB.txt)

{
  echo "Single-cell quantification -- piscem + alevin-fry against a planted count matrix"
  echo "piscem                0.23.0 (map-sc)   $(alevin-fry --version 2>&1 | tr "\n" " ")"
  echo "mapped_reads          $READS of $(awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="reads") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)   (every MAPPED read carries a UNIQUE UMI, so counts == mapped reads)"
  echo "cells_min_reads_1     $CELLS_A   (assert 3 -- all planted cells retained)"
  echo "matrix_exact          $EXACT_A   (assert yes -- EXACT: every (cell,gene,count) triple equals the planted value)"
  echo "count_sum             $SUM_A of $READS   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION: one unique UMI becomes exactly one count)"
  echo "cells_default_minreads $CELLS_B   (assert 2 -- see below)"
  echo "dropped_by_default    $DROPPED  (the 8-read cell: alevin-fry's --unfiltered-pl defaults to --min-reads 10 and drops it SILENTLY)"
  echo "unmapped_bin_header   $UHDR   (assert 1 1 3 -- version 1, one barcode field, u32)"
  echo "unmapped_bin_exact    $BIN_OK   (assert yes -- decoded per-barcode unmapped counts == the planted ones)"
  echo "featuredump_A_exact   $FD_OK_A of $FD_N_A cells   (assert 3 of 3 -- CorrectedReads == mapped + unmapped, MappingRate == mapped/that)"
  echo "featuredump_B_exact   $FD_OK_B of $FD_N_B cells   (assert 2 of 2)"
  echo "featuredump_A         $(cat fdA.txt)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$CELLS_A" -eq 3
test "$EXACT_A" = yes
test "$SUM_A" -eq "$READS"
test "$CELLS_B" -eq 2
test -n "$DROPPED"
test "$UHDR" = "1 1 3"
test "$BIN_OK" = yes
test "$FD_OK_A" -eq 3
test "$FD_N_A" -eq 3
test "$FD_OK_B" -eq 2
test "$FD_N_B" -eq 2
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
